topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: I appreciate the thought, really, but the yard—it’s a bit of a sanctuary, you know? I’ve spent a lot of time out there, just thinking, watching the sky, that sort of thing. Adding a garden, it’s a big change. I mean, I understand the appeal; fresh produce, a bit of green. I do. It’s just, well, I’m not sure about the idea of altering the space. What if it doesn’t work out? I’d hate for that to happen. Maybe there’s another spot that might work as well, somewhere with a bit more sun, perhaps? Or a raised bed? Just some thoughts. Let me know what you think.
